description: In late-nineteenth-century Turin, Lidia Poët investigates murders while challenging the legal restrictions that prevent her from practicing law. Working with her brother Enrico, journalist Jacopo and prosecutor Fourneau, she pursues cases while pressing for professional and social equality. Season 3 in this collection runs from "Blood Oath" through "Forgotten Girl", preserving the collection-local episode order and source runtimes.

s03e01.description: The arrival of an old friend with a desperate plea shakes Lidia's relationships and beliefs as she investigates a mysterious death at the circus.

s03e02.description: As Lidia and Fourneau land on opposing sides of a case that hits close to home, Enrico aids a painter whose alibi for a murder hints at a larger scandal.

s03e03.description: Jacopo volunteers to help Lidia solve a boxer's murder after Fourneau uncovers a hole in Grazia's story, forcing Enrico to frantically pivot his defense.

s03e04.description: A key witness misses his court date, leading Lidia to discover he's facing a shocking charge of his own. Consuelo begins to question Jacopo's love.

s03e05.description: The press speculates about Lidia's tryst with Fourneau, pushing Enrico to distance himself from his sister as Jacopo digs into Fontana's military career.

s03e06.description: While teaming up to search Fontana's estate, Lidia and Jacopo unearth a vital clue they hope will alter the outcome of Grazia's landmark case.
